name: Netoil Capital Ltd
summary: Netoil Capital Ltd., an independent resource company, operates as an oil and gas exploration and production company in South America. It primarily focuses on acquiring oil and gas development and/or production assets with exploration upside in Colombia. The company was formerly known as J.P. Kenny Petroleum Limited and changed its name to Netoil Capital Ltd. in April 2021. The company is based in London, the United Kingdom.
